subtitle: Out Manila · Air China
overview: Fly Manila to Beijing on Air China for a 5-day winter city break. See Tiananmen Square, the Forbidden City and the Juyongguan Great Wall, try skiing at Snow World (ticket, snow coat and ski equipment included), and spend a whole day at Universal Studios Beijing. You stay four nights in a 5-star hotel in Beijing, with a private coach and an English-speaking guide.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Jan 27–31 2027 to Feb 27–Mar 3 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Water Cube: The National Aquatics Center built for the 2008 Beijing Olympics, viewed from outside.
placeDesc.Bird’s Nest: Beijing's National Stadium, famous for its steel-lattice design, viewed from outside.
placeDesc.Wangfujing Walking Street: A busy pedestrian shopping and snack street in central Beijing.
placeDesc.Tiananmen Square: A vast public square in the heart of Beijing beside the Forbidden City entrance.
placeDesc.Forbidden City: The former imperial palace complex in central Beijing, now a museum.
placeDesc.Juyongguan Great Wall: A well-known Great Wall pass north of Beijing set in a mountain gorge.
placeDesc.Snow World: An indoor-style ski venue near Beijing where this tour includes ticket, snow coat and ski gear.
placeDesc.Universal Studios Beijing: A full-day visit to the Universal theme park in Beijing.
placeDesc.Qianmen Old Street: A restored traditional shopping street south of Tiananmen Square with old shops and eateries.
placeDesc.Xianyukou Food Street: A historic Beijing lane known for traditional local snacks and restaurants.
